_comment: Mode 'source' + task 'translate' (C4). IMPORTANT: Whisper's translate task ONLY outputs English, regardless of source language. It CANNOT target French/Romanian, that would need a separate translation model. So this takes a non-English clip and writes an ENGLISH transcript, always named .whisper.en.txt. Here we search for a short French clip; language:null lets Whisper auto-detect the source. Change 'search' to a Romanian clip to test 'ro' -> English. Keep 'limit' small; each translation is slow on CPU.
